sources.title: Revisiting the AdS Boson Stars: the Mass-Charge Relations

evidence.text: Use the on-shell Euclidean action, Gibbons–Hawking term and holographic counterterms to obtain free energies; add a Maxwell boundary term for the fixed-charge ensemble. Apply the Iyer–Wald Hamiltonian variation to derive the boson-star first law.

sources.title: Convexity, large charge and the large-N phase diagram of the φ$^{4}$ theory

evidence.text: Uses two distinct Legendre transformations: with x=|φc|² and y=m², Υ(x)=V(√x) and varpi(y)=ω(√y) are conjugate; transforming ω with respect to m gives fixed-charge free-energy density. Supremum conjugation is distinguished from stationary, potentially complex continuation.

sources.title: A scaling limit for line and surface defects

evidence.text: Introduce logarithmic sources for charge-n insertions and normalize their correlators by the defect expectation value. Position-space cutoffs extract logarithmic anomalous dimensions. For two defects, isolate the interaction action after removing the separate single-defect contributions.

sources.title: Giant Vortices and the Regge Limit

evidence.text: Quantize quadratic fluctuations with Neumann boundary conditions after mapping the strip to a finite interval. Treat the degenerate n=0 sector through a reduced two-dimensional action and finite-width corrections. Estimate boundary-layer effects by derivative-expansion power counting.

sources.title: Moduli spaces in CFT: large charge operators

evidence.text: Perturbative examples use the 4−ϵ expansion, analytic continuation in fermion multiplicity, and a large-charge double-scaling saddle. The macroscopic analysis compares conformal-block and Källén–Lehmann decompositions.

sources.title: The large-charge expansion in nonrelativistic conformal field theories

evidence.text: The microscopic calculation uses a Stratonovich transform, integrates out fermions, and expands the resulting functional determinant in gradients at large charge. ζ-function regularization is used for spectral quantities; the edge estimate employs a Mellin transform of a heat kernel.

sources.title: Goldstone bosons and convexity

evidence.text: Does consistency of Goldstone excitations constrain the charge dependence of lowest scalar operator dimensions in a CFT with global U(1), including regimes broader than the usual large-charge expansion?

sources.title: Superadditivity at large charge

evidence.text: Does the minimal charged-operator dimension satisfy Δ((n1+n2)q0) ≥ Δ(n1q0)+Δ(n2q0) for positive integers n1,n2, particularly at large charge? The paper examines the required charge spacing q0 and whether bottom-up EFT consistency can establish this conjecture.

sources.title: More on the weak gravity conjecture via convexity of charged operators

evidence.text: Which precise charged-operator inequalities express the convex charge conjecture, and do semiclassical fixed-charge spectra support them beyond small-charge perturbation theory? The paper also investigates complex dimensions and a proposed extension to different charge directions.

sources.title: Towers of Operators in CFTs and Convexity Bounds at Large Charge

evidence.text: For CFTs with moduli spaces and asymptotically linear charged towers, what bounds constrain the slope α1 and subleading coefficient α0? Can moduli-space EFT establish WGC-motivated asymptotic charge convexity?

evidence.text: Can a weak-gravity principle formulated through nonnegative self-binding energy motivate a universal constraint on the lowest dimensions of charged CFT operators, including theories without weakly curved gravitational duals?

sources.title: Bootstrapping (D, D) conformal matter

evidence.text: Does minimal (Dk,Dk) conformal matter minimize the flavor central charge among interacting six-dimensional N=(1,0) SCFTs with so(4k) flavor symmetry, and what spectrum and OPE constraints can bootstrap extremality reveal?

sources.title: On Upper Bounds in Dimension Gaps of CFT's

evidence.text: Can a CFT's first nontrivial operator, especially its first massive spin-2 operator, have arbitrarily large dimension? Holographically, can fixed-curvature internal geometries have arbitrarily large first scalar-Laplacian eigenvalue and parametrically separated KK scales?

sources.title: Superadditivity at large charge

evidence.text: Does the minimal charged-operator dimension satisfy Δ((n1+n2)q0) ≥ Δ(n1q0)+Δ(n2q0) for positive integers n1,n2, particularly at large charge? The paper examines the required charge spacing q0 and whether bottom-up EFT consistency can establish this conjecture.

sources.title: Towers of Operators in CFTs and Convexity Bounds at Large Charge

evidence.text: For CFTs with moduli spaces and asymptotically linear charged towers, what bounds constrain the slope α1 and subleading coefficient α0? Can moduli-space EFT establish WGC-motivated asymptotic charge convexity?

sources.title: Universal conductivity and central charges

evidence.text: For 1+1-dimensional CFTs, map the plane to the thermal cylinder, transform density correlators, integrate for susceptibility, and analytically continue the Fourier-space result to real frequency.

sources.title: Central Charge Bounds in 4D Conformal Field Theory

evidence.text: Functionals are finite combinations of even derivatives in a and b at z=z̄=1/2, with z=1/2+a+b and z̄=1/2+a−b. Setting Λ[1]=1 converts the stress-tensor bound into maximizing Λ[Fd,4,2] subject to nonnegativity on every allowed block vector.

sources.title: Weak gravity conjecture in the AdS/CFT correspondence

evidence.text: Test candidate bounds using protected chiral spectra and central charges in supersymmetric AdS/CFT examples, free-field spectra, and supersymmetric anomaly formulas in Veneziano-limit SQCD. The SQCD test uses the lightest protected baryon with qB=Nc and Δ=(3/2)Nc(1-Nc/Nf).

sources.title: The Weak Gravity Conjecture in three dimensions

evidence.text: Combine chemical-potential periodicity z → z + 1 with modular S transformations to obtain z → z + τ quasi-periodicity and spectral-flow invariance of the spectrum.

sources.title: Constraints on Flavored 2d CFT Partition Functions

evidence.text: Derivative linear functionals and semidefinite programming seek positivity on the vacuum and all states outside a proposed target region. A functional normalized to ρ(vac)=1 produces a contradiction if no target state exists. Continuous-charge positivity is implemented through a restricted sum-of-squares search using SDPB.

sources.title: Large N Gauge Theories with a Dense Spectrum and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Iterative a-maximization fixes the superconformal R symmetry. When a gauge-invariant chiral operator reaches or violates the stated interacting unitarity threshold, its free contribution is removed and maximization repeated. A flip field XO with W=XO O removes O from the chiral ring through its F-term.

sources.title: Towards a Swampland Global Symmetry Conjecture using weak gravity

evidence.text: Can bulk charge propagation break an apparent global symmetry on one boundary? A Higgs expectation value on the opposite boundary permits charge transfer through a WGC-required charged bulk field.

sources.title: Goldstone bosons and convexity

evidence.text: Does consistency of Goldstone excitations constrain the charge dependence of lowest scalar operator dimensions in a CFT with global U(1), including regimes broader than the usual large-charge expansion?

sources.title: Gravity as Large Scale Structure: Families of CFTs and the Higher-Spin Gap

evidence.text: Does the growth of central charge between neighboring CFTs constrain the single-trace higher-spin gap, and what structure distinguishes physical families from arbitrary sequences? Motivations include canonical central-charge scalings, bounded gaps in vector models, and the validity of semiclassical AdS gravity.

sources.title: AdS Field Theory from Conformal Field Theory

evidence.text: Which bottom-up properties of CFT correlators guarantee a perturbative AdS effective field theory with a cutoff parametrically above the curvature scale, and what constraints follow for conserved higher-spin interactions?

sources.title: Moduli spaces in CFT: large charge operators

evidence.text: What necessary signatures of conformal symmetry breaking appear in large-charge CFT data, assuming a continuous global symmetry is also broken, and how can charged operators probe massive particles on the moduli space?

sources.title: Double-Trace Flows and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can unitary CFT sequences with large central charge, sparse low-spin spectra and a parametrically large higher-spin gap lack supersymmetry? Such sequences would describe weakly coupled AdS gravity with an Einstein limit.

sources.title: Supersymmetric Cardy formula and the Weak Gravity Conjecture in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: Can a modified AdS5/CFT4 Weak Gravity Conjecture hold for every 4d N=1 SCFT, including theories without a weakly coupled Einstein gravity dual, while resolving known chiral-sector counterexamples?

sources.title: Extensions of a scale-separated AdS$_{4}$ solution and their mass spectrum

evidence.text: Can two large-n extensions of DGKT change its scalar spectrum, integer candidate CFT dimensions, or relation to the observed AdS scalar mass bound before string corrections become relevant?

sources.title: Moduli Stabilisation and the Holographic Swampland

evidence.text: How do scalar-exchange anomalous dimensions behave when external operators become heavy in AdS units? The source considers heavy–heavy, heavy–volume, and heavy–axion mixed sectors within LVS, defining heaviness by Δ_ψ→∞ as volume grows.

sources.title: Holography from Conformal Field Theory

evidence.text: Do a large-N expansion and a large single-trace spectral gap force bulk locality at distances parametrically below the AdS radius, as diagnosed by scalar four-point functions?

sources.title: Growing Extra Dimensions in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: Can leading planar operator data of a large-gap CFT determine the number D of bulk dimensions of order the AdS radius, despite classical consistent truncations obscuring extra dimensions?

sources.title: More on the weak gravity conjecture via convexity of charged operators

evidence.text: Which precise charged-operator inequalities express the convex charge conjecture, and do semiclassical fixed-charge spectra support them beyond small-charge perturbation theory? The paper also investigates complex dimensions and a proposed extension to different charge directions.

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture, Central Charges and $\eta/s$

evidence.text: Does an assumed AdS weak gravity conjecture constrain higher-derivative couplings sufficiently to enforce the KSS bound at extremality, and how do these constraints interact with holographic central-charge bounds?

sources.title: Giant Vortices and the Regge Limit

evidence.text: What are the lowest scaling dimensions Δ(Q,J) at simultaneously large U(1) charge and spin, and can an intermediate giant vortex connect the conformal superfluid description to the Regge large-spin expansion?

sources.title: Revisiting the AdS Boson Stars: the Mass-Charge Relations

evidence.text: What mass–charge relations characterize electrically charged global-AdS4 boson stars, which constructed zero-temperature states minimize energy at fixed charge, and how do unbounded branches relate to large-charge CFT expansions?

sources.title: A counterexample to the CFT convexity conjecture

evidence.text: Must every unitary CFT in d>2 with a single U(1) admit an order-one charge q0 such that its minimum operator dimensions are superadditive on all positive integer multiples of q0, or can the onset charge be parametrically delayed?

sources.title: Convexity, large charge and the large-N phase diagram of the φ$^{4}$ theory

evidence.text: How can large-charge methods determine the leading-N O(2N) φ⁴ phase diagram, and what do effective-potential convexity and charged-operator dimensions imply about stability and UV completion in 2<D<4 and 4<D<6?

sources.title: A scaling limit for line and surface defects

evidence.text: Can a large-charge-inspired scaling of bulk and defect couplings simplify the determination of defect beta functions, fixed points, profiles, charged defect-operator dimensions, and interactions between parallel defects?

sources.title: Convexity of charged operators in CFTs with multiple Abelian symmetries

evidence.text: How should the charge scale for convexity of lowest-dimension charged operators be defined independently of basis when a CFT has multiple Abelian symmetries, and can that scale become parametrically large?

sources.title: ISCOs and the weak gravity conjecture bound in higher derivative theories of gravity

evidence.text: Can charged-probe binding energies and heavy-light CFT anomalous dimensions yield WGC bounds in higher-derivative AdS gravity, and does the disappearance of physical ISCOs coincide with those bounds?

sources.title: Loops in AdS from Conformal Field Theory

evidence.text: How can tree-level large-N CFT data and crossing symmetry determine one-loop AdS four-point amplitudes and nonplanar OPE data, including the ambiguities associated with bulk renormalization?

sources.title: Rigorous Holographic Bound on AdS Scale Separation

evidence.text: Can Coulomb-branch constraints bound the number and dimensions of operators at large central charge, thereby limiting AdS5 scale separation and excluding some semiclassical pure-supergravity limits?

sources.title: Universal Bounds on Charged States in 2d CFT and 3d Gravity

evidence.text: Does modular invariance force charged states below a universal energy bound in a 2d CFT with an abelian current, and constrain their energy-to-charge ratio? What follows for charged spectra in AdS3 gravity?

sources.title: Tests of the Charge Convexity Conjecture in Caswell-Banks-Zaks theory

evidence.text: Does the Charge Convexity Conjecture (CCC), including its proposed extension to products of global-symmetry factors, hold for the lowest charged mesons at weakly coupled four-dimensional Caswell–Banks–Zaks fixed points?

sources.title: Anomalies and Bounds on Charged Operators

evidence.text: Does a global symmetry's ’t Hooft anomaly constrain the scaling dimension of the lightest charged local operator, and determine whether a universal upper bound exists?
